title: Bigville offline retrieval set
provenance: Expected files were selected by reading Bigville implementations and focused tests in the read-only checkout. These frozen labels are supplied to Ozagia; the evaluator never imports Bigville.

tasks.task: Saving and restoring a running session should preserve enough state to continue the same simulation after restart.
tasks.notes: Session checkpoint implementation and focused roundtrip tests.

tasks.task: Repeated population summaries with the same sampling seed should report stable estimates and uncertainty while retaining exact counts.
tasks.notes: Reporting computes exact values and seeded finite population sample estimates.

tasks.task: Large action menus should be generated on demand when the configured automatic mode detects that eager enumeration is too costly.
tasks.notes: Mode resolution lives in Game; lazy evaluation behavior has dedicated tests.

tasks.task: When concurrent actions claim the same scarce item, resolution should choose a deterministic winner and leave conflicting claims rejected.
tasks.notes: Pure claim arbitration and its executor tests are the relevant implementation and validation sites.

tasks.task: Restoring a saved knowledge graph should preserve loaded seed manifests and reject malformed manifest data instead of silently losing it.
tasks.notes: Graph checkpoint encoding and seed manifest validation are implemented in runtime; node provenance tests cover loaded origins.

tasks.task: All cognition providers should submit decisions through one shared contract so a provider cannot bypass the world's action checks.
tasks.notes: Backend interface, game decision loop, and backend contract tests.

tasks.task: Scenario loading should accept structured in memory definitions and file paths while producing a clear validation failure for malformed input.
tasks.notes: Scenario loader and scenario validation suite.

tasks.task: The public entry point should build a game from a selected scenario and seed while keeping provider and runtime choices configurable.
tasks.notes: Public API construction and defaults tests.
